title.zh: Robinhood engineers face up to 30 years over $50,000 alleged Hyperliquid profits

current_state.zh: Two Robinhood engineers were federally charged with using confidential token-listing information to profit over $50,000 each trading Hyperliquid perpetual futures, testing how insider-trading laws apply to decentralized crypto derivatives.
